title: Belgium unemployment rate, September 2026
question: What will Eurostat first report for Belgium's September 2026 seasonally adjusted total unemployment rate, both sexes, ages 15-74, in une_rt_m?

resolutionRule: Resolve to the first official Eurostat numerical print for September 2026 in une_rt_m with freq=M, geo=BE, s_adj=SA, age=TOTAL, sex=T and unit=PC_ACT: seasonally adjusted total unemployment, both sexes, ages 15-74, as a percentage of the labour force.
